definitions.explanation: The direction in which a person is looking, or the act of looking at someone. Often used to describe the feeling of being watched or to indicate where someone's attention is directed.

examples.japanese: {視線|しせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt someone's gaze on me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{視線|しせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そらして⟦{黙|だま}った→黙る：02287_damaru⟧。
examples.english: He averted his gaze and fell silent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{視線|しせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になって→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧、⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{話|はな}せなかった→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I was so conscious of the people around me staring that I couldn't speak well.

notes:
USAGE:
{視線|しせん} emphasizes the directional, almost physical quality of a gaze — it can be felt, directed, or avoided. Compare with ⟦{目線|めせん}→目線：13650_mesen⟧ (eye level, perspective), which is more casual and also used figuratively (⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦{目線|めせん}→目線：13650_mesen⟧ = from a child's perspective).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {視線|しせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel someone's gaze
- {視線|しせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そらす: to avert one's eyes
- {視線|しせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}ける→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧: to direct one's gaze
- {視線|しせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to make eye contact
- {視線|しせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: all eyes gather (on someone)
